description: This file defines the implementation of the Args class, which manages build arguments, overrides, and system variables for a build system, including methods for declaring arguments, applying overrides, and setting system-specific variables.

classes.name: Args
classes.description: Manages build arguments, overrides, and system variables for the build system.

classes.name: Args::ValueWithOverride
classes.description: Represents a build argument value with override information.

methods.name: AddArgOverride
methods.description: Adds an override for a specific argument.

methods.name: GetArgOverride
methods.description: Retrieves an override value for a given argument.

methods.name: GetSortedToolchainsLocked
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of toolchains.

methods.name: GetArgFromAllArguments
methods.description: Retrieves an argument value from all sources.

methods.name: SetupRootScope
methods.description: Sets up the root scope with system variables and overrides.

methods.name: DeclareArgs
methods.description: Declares build arguments within a scope.

methods.name: VerifyAllOverridesUsed
methods.description: Checks if all overrides have been used.

methods.name: GetAllArguments
methods.description: Returns all arguments with override information.

methods.name: SetSystemVarsLocked
methods.description: Sets system-specific variables in the scope.

methods.name: ApplyOverridesLocked
methods.description: Applies argument overrides to a scope.

methods.name: DeclaredArgumentsForToolchainLocked
methods.description: Returns declared arguments for a specific toolchain.

methods.name: OverridesForToolchainLocked
methods.description: Returns overrides for a specific toolchain.
